answer: One concrete mechanism: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because comet only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, walnut is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any pulse approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
